test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Why do we have to accept these conditions?

options.text: Why do these conditions have to be accepted?
Why should these conditions be accepted?
These conditions do not have to be accepted.
Why are these conditions needed to be accepted?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• In the given active sentence, 'these conditions' is the object.
 
• The passive form of the sentence follows the structure:
 
 
• **Why + be + subject + past participle + Object ( not mandatory ) + ?**
 
 

Hence, the correct passive form is: ***Why do these conditions have to be accepted?***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ***Additional Information__***

 
• Option 2 =** Incorrect** = It doesn't follow the proper structure of interrogative passive voice. 
 
• Option 3 = **Incorrec**t = It doesn't follow the proper structure of interrogative passive voice. 
 
• Option 4 =** Incorrect** = It doesn't follow the proper structure of interrogative passive voice.
